newsitem.title: USA: Grand Casinos ends pact with Stratosphere.
newsitem.headline: Grand Casinos ends pact with Stratosphere.

text.p: Grand Casinos Inc said Friday it withdrew its support of Stratosphere Corp's reorganization plan and that it has ended its related investment pact with Stratosphere.

Grand Casinos said Friday evening that Stratosphere was unable to achieve the minimum required consolidated cash flow as defined in their agreement and that it has entered a new pact with Stratosphere.
The new pact accompanies Stratosphere's filing of an amended reorganization plan, Grand Casinos said.
